snippet.title: Ritualis: Summoner Simulator Trailer
snippet.description:
Steam: https://store.steampowered.com/app/3576580/Ritualis_Summoner_Simulator/

Start your business and turn it big! Summon a hat, a chicken, or an Ancient God. Save the world—or don’t.

As a summoner-for-hire, you’ve just opened a shop in a medieval town where everyone urgently needs something summoned. New pants? You got it! A pocket dragon? No problem! A swarm of angry bees? Questionable… but sure.

Buy ingredients, draw magic circles (preferably not wonky), and fulfill requests until you run out of money, luck, or patience. (Seriously, what is wrong with these people?!)

Between summoning cats and seductive demons, maybe try to figure out who you really are.
Why don’t you remember your life before the shop? How did you even end up in this town? And what’s the deal with that shady Merchant?

Oh, and about that amnesia—don’t forget to pay your taxes. Or do. Prison’s a perfectly fine place for a nap, right?

You might go bankrupt, become a local legend, or accidentally trigger the apocalypse. It’s all up to you. Well… mostly up to you.

Features:

- Summon objects, creatures, and "surprises"
- Weird and wonderful clients with even weirder requests
- Upgrade your shop, stock up on ingredients, learn new rituals
- Magic, absurdity, and humor
- Multiple endings—from legendary success to "welp, that escalated quickly"

Open the door to a world where every order is a chance to make a coin… or destroy half the town!
